selection.strategy: next 10 after Dijk en Waard; initial search + deep search + mandatory retest before leaving any municipality open

findings: The current municipal Omgevingsplan is the operative spatial framework and explicitly governs permitted building/use at location level.
The municipality publishes a current Volkshuisvestingsprogramma 2025-2029.
After a second search/retest no sufficiently specific current dedicated Huisvestingsverordening, opkoopbescherming, general room-rental or dwelling-splitting ordinance was positively established.
This is not encoded as absence of restrictions: exact room-rental/splitting/use-change questions must be resolved against the Omgevingsplan and any activity-specific decision/policy.
records.openReason: specific current stock/room-rental framework not positively established after retest; address-level omgevingsplan remains authoritative

findings: Huisvestingsverordening Gemeente Doesburg 2024 is current through 30 December 2027.

The 2026 leges regulation contains an operative fee item for a verhuurvergunning opkoopbescherming and for a rental permit under the Wet goed verhuurderschap, while conversion/formation/splitting/tourist-rental items are reserved.

Because a fee item alone is not the substantive legal basis for opkoopbescherming, the exact current protected-housing scope and exceptions require article/source consolidation before threshold-level product encoding.

The municipality still publishes the 2021 room-rental policy as its operative route: hospitaverhuur requires an omgevingsvergunning, allows at most two rooms, minimum 8 m2 each, one occupant per room, and requires 60% of the dwelling for private use of the main occupant; business dwellings are excluded.
Current rural-housing policy explicitly allows dwelling splitting and other additional residential forms subject to its conditions.

A 2026 adopted Omgevingsplan amendment demonstrates address-specific splitting of an existing dwelling into two independent dwellings, confirming that splitting can require location-specific plan amendment/assessment.
The current 2026 version of the doelgroepenverordening regulates designated affordable housing but must not be confused with general room-rental or splitting permission.
Beleidsregels Hospitaverhuur gemeente Dongen 2025 are current from 28 November 2025 and define hospitaverhuur as owner-occupied letting to at most one person under that policy.

Current municipal guidance states ordinary room rental is prohibited under the single-household spatial framework, with a permit route for housing labour migrants; an omgevingsvergunning is always required for that exception route.
Legacy spatial-plan texts also expressly classify use of a dwelling for room rental as contrary use, reinforcing that address-level plan rules must be checked.
General dwelling splitting was not positively established as a citywide simple rule and remains an omgevingsplan/address question.
The current Huisvestingsverordening gemeente Dordrecht is valid from 17 April 2026 onward after its first 2026 amendment.
The regulation contains a splitsingsvergunning regime for buildings containing housing, including document, maintenance and housing-stock assessment requirements.

Opkoopbescherming applies municipality-wide to qualifying dwellings with WOZ value no higher than the NHG cost limit for existing homes without energy-saving measures, subject to acquisition/use conditions.
The protected rental period is four years after registration of the deed; statutory and municipal permit grounds and withdrawal rules are explicitly regulated.
Beleidsregels generatiewonen en woningsplitsing are current from 5 November 2025 and serve as the assessment framework for omgevingsvergunning applications.

Municipal guidance confirms a permit is required and states conditions including own-site parking, preservation of character/environment, no disproportionate restriction of surrounding businesses and independent access/facilities for a split dwelling.
For newly split dwellings the municipality states a self-occupancy obligation and anti-speculation clause of at least five years.
Old 2007/2012 housing-allocation regulations are rejected as current evidence.
Beleidsregel Huisvesting Arbeidsmigranten gemeente Drimmelen 2025 is current and contains explicit criteria for kamergewijze verhuur in regular dwellings for labour migrants.
The route requires spatial deviation/assessment and criteria include Bbl compliance, balanced allocation of functions, current parking standards and a fire-safety notification.
This is a targeted labour-migrant framework and must not be generalized to ordinary room rental for all target groups; general splitting/room-rental questions remain separately address/use specific.
Municipal guidance confirms that splitting or major renovation with a permit results in new BAG house numbers, confirming a formal permit/BAG route for actual dwelling division.
After the mandatory second search/retest no sufficiently specific current dedicated Huisvestingsverordening, opkoopbescherming or citywide room-rental/splitting policy was positively established.
No unrestricted-use conclusion is drawn; exact legality remains dependent on the current Omgevingsplan and the requested activity/address.
records.openReason: specific citywide stock/room-rental framework not positively established after retest; permit and address-level spatial assessment remain required

findings: Huisvestingsverordening Gemeente Druten 2024 is current from 31 December 2023 onward.
The municipality's current regulations index also lists Beleidsregels Huisvesting Internationale Werknemers Druten and the current Omgevingsplan.

The confirmed Huisvestingsverordening is principally an allocation framework; room rental/splitting for a specific address must also be checked against the international-worker policy where relevant and the Omgevingsplan.
Huisvestingsverordening Gemeente Duiven 2024 is current through 5 January 2028.

The municipality also has spatial policy history expressly addressing room rental and noting interaction with dwelling-splitting rules; because that policy predates the Omgevingswet it is used as a routing clue, not as a stand-alone 2026 conclusion.
The current Huisvestingsverordening must be combined with current address-level Omgevingsplan rules for room rental or physical/function splitting.
